propositions: A single Gerrit Verified run requires 21 concurrent job slots but navapbc org is limited to 20 total concurrent jobs on GitHub Free, causing later runs to queue 6.7-8.4m waiting for macOS slots.
The current _optionality.yml workflow fans out 6 separate matrix cells (5 per-extra + union) each holding a checkout+setup+install slot for 0.4-0.8m of real work, wasting parallelization budget.

The per-extra matrix list contains {agents, eval, tracing, mcp, grounding} but _optional.EXTRAS contains {agents, eval, grounding, metrics, tracing}, so metrics has no per-extra CI coverage and mcp lacks a detection probe.

Collapsing per-extra jobs into a single venv-loop job running isolation iterations plus one union iteration reduces peak concurrent slots from 6 to 1 while covering all extras and validating joint dependency resolution.
